sentences.en: I always feel comfortable. The temperature is usually very cool and the shopping carts stroll really smooth down the aisles.

sentences.en: When I'm ready to check out all of my groceries,?

sentences.en: I normally try to go to selfch checkout. The lines the queue is usually shorter than regular checkout. So selfch checkout is a lot faster.

sentences.en: I always prefer to get my fresh produce like vegetables and fruits at the local market.
sentences.tc: 我總是喜歡在當地市場購買蔬菜和水果等新鮮農產品。
